# build function rotate/reflection holes on n x n

def symm_mask(mask,n):
 arr=np.zeros((n,n),dtype=int)
 for r,c in mask:arr[r,c]=1
 outs=[]
 for k in range(4):
  a=np.rot90(arr,k)
  outs.append(a)
  outs.append(np.fliplr(a))
 return [set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(a))) for a in outs]
# demo2 centered min hamming across 8 symmetries
